messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image, using the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the scene in the video with the environment shown in the reference image. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands facing away from the camera, then turns his head and upper body to the right before turning back to face forward.","camera":"The camera is static, positioned at a medium distance behind the subject at roughly waist height.","clothing":"He wears a white sleeveless tank top with a pink and blue palm tree graphic, light blue shorts, and red sneakers.","hair_color":"Dark brown or black.","hairstyle":"He has short, dark hair.","identity":"A muscular, dark-skinned man is seen from behind, with a tattoo visible on his upper back.","scene":"The setting is a wet, reflective urban plaza in front of a large glass building with glowing pink and green neon lights and a circular digital display."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background was replaced from a daytime rooftop with buildings and a satellite dish to a wet urban plaza in front of a large glass building with pink and green neon lights and a circular digital display, matching the reference. The man remains in a similar rear medium shot, performs a comparable head/upper-body turn, and wears the same white palm-tree tank top and light blue shorts. His skin appears darker and he now wears red sneakers instead of being barefoot.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the source rooftop scene with the reference environment while preserving the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, action, camera framing, and natural lighting.
uncertain: Whether the person's identity and facial expression were fully preserved, since the face is mostly not visible.
unexpected_changes: The man's skin tone appears noticeably darker in the output.
The man is now wearing red sneakers, while the source showed him barefoot.
The person's apparent build and proportions look somewhat different in the output.
